retain_mission: Extract only source-supported facts. Preserve who said or did each thing, the speaker's role, and explicit or useful time information. Distinguish hypothetical or unverified claims from completed events, solo events from shared events, and whether the user participated. Preserve explicit uncertainty. Distinguish a factual correction (an earlier value was mistaken) from a preference change (a new value applies from a stated time onward). Classify each fact independently based on its proposition, not its source or conversation. Where useful, separate a portable subject-owned property or preference from a narrative about how it arose. A standalone profile fact may state a current preference, a clearly time-bounded former preference, an explicitly corrected value, or an explicit preference change; preserve meaningful values and temporal distinctions without including private source or interaction provenance. A former value or correction is not private solely because it is historical. Use kind:profile only when that fact is understandable and useful without knowing a particular character, assistant, chat, or private origin. Keep private origin, who participated, where a statement was made, assistant actions or confirmations, and relationship-specific events in separate character-root facts without kind:profile. Never profile-tag a whole source or copy earlier context into a fact. Do not infer an unstated value, correction, change, time, event status, speaker, or participation; leave kind unset when portability is unclear.
observations_mission: Summarize only source-supported facts in the supplied character-root observation scope. Preserve user versus assistant attribution, temporal correction versus preference change, solo versus shared experience, and explicit uncertainty. Never turn hypotheses into events.

entity_labels.description: Fact-level portability classification. Use profile for a standalone subject-owned property or preference, including a current value, a clearly time-bounded former value, an explicit correction, or an explicit change when source-supported and useful without interaction history. Do not label private origin, source or chat details, participant or assistant narrative, assistant actions, or relationship-specific experiences. A profile label does not make the source or relationship shareable; leave unset when the fact's portability is unclear.

values.description: A standalone subject-owned property or preference, including a supported current or clearly time-bounded historical value or correction, with no private origin or interaction narrative in the fact.
